sourceText: User asked: 那就开始执行吧，好了告诉我. Context: create a small story to solve safe Cell03 Parallel Shard Runner so multiple agents can eventually parallelize B-991d Cell03 without polluting experiment evidence.
normalizedOutcome: A canonical Cell03 shard helper exists and can be locally selfchecked, proving deterministic shard coverage, per-shard lock behavior, and merge rejection of duplicate, missing, or digest-drift rows without running provider work.
acceptanceClaim: Running the local Cell03 shard selfcheck exits 0 and reports coverage, lock, merge-success, duplicate-reject, missing-reject, and digest-drift-reject checks passing.
